experiences.name: AriveGuru Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
experiences.description: Developed applications for medical firms, enhancing user health tracking and assessments while learning to handle sensitive personal data securely and comply with industry standards. Built RHIA, an AI assistant for tasks including user registration, appointment scheduling, and task management, deployable across multiple office locations, leveraging AI technologies to streamline office operations and improve productivity. Created a JSON to React Native component converter to improve frontend management and development efficiency. Directly coordinated with clients to translate their requirements into pixel-perfect solutions, consistently meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality, responsive designs and interfaces that gained confidence in frontend skills and knowledge.

experiences.name: Konversi Pvt. Ltd.
experiences.description: Developed a Fleet Management App with comprehensive job flow management, job history tracking, and real-time location tracking for job assignments, along with image uploads and technician maintenance workflows. Built a POS App for park operations that handled up to 1000+ transactions per day, integrating thermal printer support, transaction history management, and report data printing capabilities. Created an Attendance Logging App using Expo's geolocation services and camera-based photo verification to enforce secure clock-in/out functionality, manage leave requests, and track daily work hours for employees.

experiences.name: Lovepack Consumers Pvt. Ltd.
experiences.description: Developed three major applications: EazyDukan, a multilingual retail management platform (mobile & web) featuring subscription tiers, multi-outlet and staff management, a full POS system with real-time inventory tracking, AI-powered menu scanning, promotional material generation, and online ordering with delivery coordination. Built WebRasoi, a restaurant-focused version with enhanced AI-based menu creation from photos and streamlined inventory management. Created Zluper, a thrift fashion marketplace with an Instagram Reels-like feed optimized with HLS video streaming and WebP images, featuring wishlisting, rewards, referrals, wallet cashbacks, creator program, and a comprehensive admin dashboard for managing inventory, orders, and platform operations. All projects utilized modern tech stacks including React Native, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and various cloud services.

experiences.name: PW (PhysicsWallah) Skills
experiences.description: Developed an in-depth React Native course tailored for students to learn React Native from the ground up, with a special focus on developing applications using Expo, ensuring comprehensive coverage of essential skills and concepts. Provided extensive guidance to students through a variety of detailed examples, hands-on exercises, and real-world projects, ensuring students gained a practical and thorough understanding of React Native development that enabled them to apply their knowledge effectively. Carefully structured the course content to cover all critical aspects of React Native, from initial setup and basic components to advanced features and optimization techniques, creating a robust curriculum designed to offer students a well-rounded and deep learning experience in React Native.

experiences.name: Trial & Error Inc.
experiences.description: Contributed to the development of RenovateAI, an AI-powered home design application that enables users to visualize and plan home renovations by transforming photos of their spaces into professionally styled interiors with virtual staging, wall paint previews, and furniture arrangement. Completely revamped key user-facing features including the onboarding flow, renovation experience, and home screen, resulting in increased user conversions. Implemented comprehensive accessibility (a11y) improvements across all features worked on, ensuring the app is usable and inclusive for all users. Improved the legacy codebase architecture and optimized performance throughout the app, significantly reducing technical debt and enhancing overall app responsiveness. Handled on-call responsibilities and resolved critical production bugs to ensure a seamless and frictionless user experience for homeowners planning their renovation projects.

description.short: Multilingual retail management platform (mobile & web) with subscription tiers, multi-outlet management, full POS system, and AI-powered features. Web platform provides a large UI for managing inventory, adding transactions (POS), and quick commerce functionality.
description.long: Developed a multilingual retail management app (mobile & web) featuring subscription tiers, multi-outlet and staff management, a full POS system with real-time inventory tracking, and support for cash, QR code, and Razorpay SMS payments. Integrated AI capabilities to auto-scan restaurant menus into inventory, generate promotional materials, manage coupons, handle product returns, and offer a one-click "86" function, alongside detailed sales, revenue, and analytics reporting. Built online ordering with delivery coordination (in-house or third-party), WhatsApp-based customer feedback, and a Customer Display mode for scrolling in-store promotions. The web project is mainly the mobile app but easier to manage stuff like a large UI for managing inventory, adding transactions (POS), etc. The shop.eazydukan.com is a quick commerce platform that shows shops nearby, and users could buy from them. The "shop" is a wildcard subdomain and could be named to anything based on your eazydukan account, so you could advertise your shop as dominos.eazydukan.com and it would take the user to a page where the user could purchase anything from your shop online, and the store owner could have it delivered to them.

description.short: Restaurant-focused version of EazyDukan with enhanced functionality for restaurants, including AI-based menu creation, one-click "86" feature, and AI-generated images and descriptions for a polished experience.
description.long: WebRasoi is a restaurant-focused version of EazyDukan with way better functionality specifically designed for restaurants. It features AI-based inventory (menu) creation, one-click "86" feature for out-of-stock items, and AI-generated images and descriptions so it never felt bland. Similar to EazyDukan, when adding inventory, you could just take a picture of what the item is, and AI would fill all of the relevant details, ask you to confirm, and done. This streamlined the menu creation process and ensured consistent, professional-looking menu items with AI-generated content.

description.short: Thrift fashion app where users can discover and purchase amazing thrift clothing from top brands. Features an Instagram Reels-like feed with HLS-optimized video streaming via expo-video and WebP-optimized images, wishlisting, rewards, referrals, wallet cashbacks, and a creator program for influencer events. Built an admin dashboard for easier management of inventory, data, orders, and more.
description.long: Zluper is a thrift fashion app where users can checkout amazing thrift clothing from top brands, buy them, share them, buy them for friends, get rewards, and participate in influencer events through Zluper's creator program (sign up available on web). The mobile version is WAY better with an Instagram Reels-like feed on the homescreen that you can scroll through all day to checkout amazing fashion. It uses HLS with expo-video for videos to ensure network quality does not affect how fast/slow the media loads, only the quality, and WebP format with expo-image for optimized image loading. The app leverages Expo Application Services (EAS) for OTA updates and easier version releases on app stores. Key features include the performant Instagram Reels-like feed with support for both videos and images, wishlisting, buying, coupon codes, referrals, sharing, rewards, wallet cashbacks, referral earnings, and more. The web version is also available for purchasing, though the mobile experience is significantly enhanced. Additionally, I built a comprehensive admin dashboard that provides easier management of inventory, inventory data, orders, and other administrative tasks, streamlining the backend operations for the platform.

description.short: Comprehensive mobile app designed to support Veterans in their health and well-being journey, offering educational resources, personalized content on therapeutic areas, VA facility directory, and information on eligibility and benefits.
description.long: BVMRF Vet-Health is a comprehensive mobile application designed to support Veterans in their health and well-being journey. It offers a wealth of educational resources, personalized content on specific therapeutic areas, and valuable information on VA-related topics and services. Users can access a vast library of educational content tailored to their specific needs, stay informed about relevant therapeutic areas, and learn about the latest treatments and therapies available for Veterans. The app also provides a comprehensive directory of VA facilities and services, guidance on eligibility and benefits, and updates on VA-related news. Additionally, it keeps users informed about advancements in medical research and clinical trials, offering opportunities to participate in studies that may benefit them and contribute to the advancement of Veterans healthcare. The app is developed by the Bronx Veterans Medical Research Foundation (BVMRF), a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing research and education activities to enhance the quality of care and health for Veterans.

description.long: Built RHIA, an AI assistant for tasks like user registration, appointment scheduling, and task management, deployable across multiple office locations. description.short: AI-powered home design and renovation app with virtual staging, 3D elevations, image upscaling, and over 100 curated styles. Revamped onboarding and home screen, significantly improving user conversions and app performance.
description.long: Worked on various projects/part of the Renovate AI mobile app, such as completely revamping the onboarding, renovation experience, home screen, and more, increasing user conversions. Worked on improving legacy codebase and increased performance throughout the app, removing a huge chunk of technical debt. Handled on-call as well as critical bugs in production, ensuring end users have a frictionless app experience. Renovate AI is a cutting-edge application that revolutionizes home design and renovation processes using advanced AI. It features virtual staging, 3D elevations, image upscaling to 4K, exterior renovation, landscaping design with over 40 styles, sketch-to-render capabilities, wall makeovers, exterior painting, and object removal. The app is powered by over 10 AI models and offers more than 100 curated styles for interior and exterior design.

description.short: Mobile app for creating secure, time-limited, view-only access links to private GitHub repositories. Perfect for developers sharing code with recruiters, clients, or collaborators without compromising security.
description.long: PrivyCode revolutionizes how developers share their code by creating secure, time-limited, view-only access links to private GitHub repositories. No more making your code public or managing complex permissions. Key features include secure by design (code stays private, only shared content is accessible), time-limited access with expiration dates, view-only access (recipients can view but cannot clone, download, or modify), usage analytics to track who viewed code and when, instant sharing to generate secure links in seconds, and mobile-first design to manage shared links on the go. Perfect for developers sharing code with recruiters, freelancers showing work to potential clients, teams collaborating with external reviewers, and open source maintainers sharing private projects.

description.short: AI landscaping app: photograph your yard, get Gemini-rendered redesigns you can iterate on, then a buildable plan with plants suited to your region. Built end to end: the Expo SDK 56 / React Native new-architecture app and its Cloudflare Workers backend (Hono, D1, R2, Queues).
description.long: YardPlan lets homeowners photograph their yard and see it redesigned by AI. Each render can branch from the original photo or from an earlier render, so users explore variations without losing their place, and a finished design turns into a buildable plan with region-appropriate plants. Built the product end to end. The mobile app runs on Expo SDK 56 and React Native 0.85 (new architecture only) with React 19 and the React Compiler, expo-router file-based routing, and a strict layered architecture (utils, services, api, hooks, providers, screens) enforced by repo rules. It ships Firebase auth (Google, Apple, Facebook, passwordless email), RevenueCat subscriptions and paywalls, iOS widgets, share-intent and Branch deep links, push notifications, an offline mode, Lingui i18n, and PostHog analytics with a generated event catalog, styled through semantic theme tokens via uniwind. The backend is a Firebase-authenticated Cloudflare Worker on Hono with D1 for data, R2 for photos and renders, and Cloudflare Queues driving the Gemini render and plan pipelines asynchronously, so a render survives the app closing. Both sides use Drizzle, Biome/ultracite, tests and husky to keep the codebase consistent.
